name: happy-pet-harbor
description: Happy Pet Harbor storefront, customer accounts and account cart

scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute happy-pet-harbor-shop --remote --command "SELECT day,name,count FROM events WHERE day>=date('now','-14 day') ORDER BY day DESC,name"
scripts.orders: wrangler d1 execute happy-pet-harbor-shop --remote --command "SELECT datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS paid_utc,color,amount,discount,ship_name,ship_line1,ship_line2,ship_city,ship_state,ship_zip,ship_country,phone,email FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
